element.definition: This resource is primarily used for the identification and definition of a medication for the purposes of prescribing, dispensing, and administering a medication as well as for making statements about medication use.

element.definition: A reference to a set of rules that were followed when the resource was constructed, and which must be understood when processing the content. Often, this is a reference to an implementation guide that defines the special rules along with other profiles etc.

element.short: Text summary of the resource, for human interpretation
element.definition: A human-readable narrative that contains a summary of the resource and can be used to represent the content of the resource to a human. The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

element.short: Current trade name (authorised name) of the medicinal product.
element.definition: Name of the medicinal product. This is typically the name of a real product as registered. This element should not contain display names of virtual product concepts.

element.short: Classifications of the product, e.g ATC, narcotic/psychotropic, orphan drug, etc
element.definition: Medication classification/category. Allows the product to be classified by various systems, e.g ATC, narcotic class, legal status of supply, etc..

element.short: Size of one item (for example, in a pack of 5 vials, this would represent the size of 1 vial)
element.definition: Size of a manufactured item or unit of presentation. For example, size of one vial in a package that may contain several vials.

element.short: Specifies other descriptive properties of the medication.
element.definition: Any characteristic of the medicinal product prescribed or dispensed (for example, price, textual package description, special program information, etc)

element.short: Unit of presentation of the product (e.g. tablet, vial, ampoule, etc)
element.definition: Unit of presentation, typically describing the smallest countable package item (e.g tablet, vial, ampoule, etc). Unit of presentation is also often used in describing pack size and the denominator of strength. If the size of presentation unit is relevant, it should be described in sizeOfItem extension.

element.short: Type of container. This information is more relevant in cases when the packaging has an impact on administration of the product (e.g. pre-filled syringe)
element.definition: This extension applies to Medication and expresses the type of the container for the product (e.g. bottle, unit-dose blister, pre-filled pen).

element.short: Device, typically an administration device, included in the product.
element.definition: Device, typically an administration device, included in the medicinal product.

element.short: Identifier for the medicinal product, its generic representation, or packaged product (e.g. EMA PMS ID on product or package level)
element.definition: Business identifier for this medication.

element.short: A terminology-based code for the product (e.g. SNOMED CT code)
element.definition: A code (or set of codes) that specify this medication, or a textual description if no code is available. Usage note: This could be a standard medication code such as a code from RxNorm, SNOMED CT, IDMP etc. It could also be a national or local formulary code, optionally with translations to other code systems.

binding.description: A coded concept that defines the type of a medication.

element.definition: A code to indicate if the medication is in active use.

binding.description: A coded concept defining if the medication is in active use.

element.short: Marketing authorisation holder of the medicinal product. If the product does not have a marketing authorisation, the manufactured information may be used. It is sufficient to populate only name and optionally an identifier of the organisation.
element.definition: Describes the details of the manufacturer of the medication product.  This is not intended to represent the distributor of a medication product.
Describes the form of the item.  Powder; tablets; capsule.

element.short: Amount of the medication (for example, in a package or a vial)
element.definition: Specific amount of the drug in the packaged product.  For example, when specifying a product that has the same strength (For example, Insulin glargine 100 unit per mL solution for injection), this attribute provides additional clarification of the package amount (For example, 3 mL, 10mL, etc.).

element.short: Ingredient or a part product. For combination packs, each ingredient can be a separate manufactured item with its own ingredients, dose form, and strength
element.definition: Identifies a particular constituent of interest in the product.
